name: Walter Dee Huddleston
summary: Walter Darlington "Dee" Huddleston (April 15, 1926 – October 16, 2018) was an American commercial broadcaster and politician from Kentucky. A member of the Democratic Party, he served as a member of the Kentucky Senate representing Kentucky's 10th Senate district from 1966 to 1972 and as a member of the United States Senate for two terms from 1973 to 1985. He was defeated for re-election in 1984 by Mitch McConnell by 5,269 votes.
